Karthik — thanks for the ping. Finance is comfortable with a constrained, temporary invoice-only onboarding for pilots under specific safeguards. Summary of conditions we will require for this exception: 

- Maximum aggregate spend for the pilot: $10,000 (anything above must follow standard PO flow).
- Invoice terms: Net-30 from invoice date; invoices to be sent to ap@redwood.com with Thermion AI AP contact CC'd.
- Vendor must complete vendor intake form and provide a valid W-9 (or equivalent tax form for non-US entities) before the first invoice is paid.
- Approval duration: 90 days from the vendor intake sign-off; any extension requires re-approval by Finance.
- Risk controls: single invoice cap of $7,500 and a final reconciliation invoice at pilot close.

If Karthik gets the vendor intake form and W-9, Finance will sign off and I will add an internal approval note. I'm attaching the vendor intake template for your use (vendor-intake-form.pdf). Please flag if Thermion is non-US and needs alternate tax paperwork.
